# Minecraft-Stats

**URL**: https://mc-stats.fr
**Description**: Minecraft-Stats is an advanced analytics and tracking platform designed for Minecraft servers (Java and Bedrock editions).

## Core Features
- **Server Analytics**: We collect massive amounts of data about servers, offering historical player count tracking, uptime monitoring, and advanced data visualizations (charts, sparklines).
- **Alert System**: Web push notifications for server administrators when their server goes offline (downtime) or crosses specific player thresholds (spikes).
- **Server Comparison**: Compare multiple servers simultaneously to analyze trends, popularity, and market share.
- **Real-time Data**: Frequent data collection to provide up-to-date metrics on connected players, versions, and server status.

## Target Audience
- **Server Administrators**: To monitor their server's performance, track player retention, receive downtime alerts, and understand their community growth.
- **Players**: To discover the most popular and active Java and Bedrock servers at any given time, and see which ones perform the best.

## Data Points Collected
- Online/Offline status (Uptime)
- Current player count
- Maximum player capacity
- Server MOTD (Message of the Day)
- Server Favicon/Logo
- Minecraft Version (e.g., 1.21)
- Platform Type (Java or Bedrock)
- Player sample lists
